preconditions.description: Contract must be activated (trading open, fees enabled, swap enabled)
Attacker must hold at least minRewardBalance of LLG tokens to be eligible for rewards

exploit_hint: Call setClaimRewardAsTokensPercentage(100) as any address (not just owner) to set your reward claim percentage to 100%. This will cause all your reward claims to be paid as LLG tokens instead of BNB, potentially allowing you to manipulate token price or receive more favorable tax treatment. Combine with normal reward claiming to exploit.
